Customer Receivable/Liability 

As a system user

I want to view all the receivables and liabilities which are connected to the customer

So that I will be able to get all the necessary information regarding the customer related receivable and liabilities

Design:https://xd.adobe.com/view/e1b2bacf-b75f-4a27-9c9a-cea906ab424c-b4e1/screen/8200be88-826a-4930-b807-6a5568a3f693 [SS1] 

Acceptance criteria:

  1. Due date for should be listed

  2. Date format: DD.MM.YYYY

  3. 'Liabilities and receivables' tab is displayed in the customer page, after “Invoice” tab

    1. Check system user permissions to view Liabilities and receivables tab

      1. Permission - View Customer Liabilities and receivables

        1. Allows to see all the customer related Liabilities and receivables in the system

  4. On the Liabilities and receivables tab system should load list of customer related Liabilities and receivables:

    1. Format of the tab:

      1. By default should load latest not covered receivables and liaibilities, excluding deposits

      2. By default should display 25 records in one page with the possibility to change the number of displayed items in a page.

      3. Liabilities from proforma invoice will be excluded always from this list

      4. Hardcoded values for dropdown: 25, 50, 100

      5. Total count of customer receivables and liabilities should be loaded

      6. Pagination:

        1. To be able to navigate through next/previous page

        2. To be able to navigate to first/last page

        3. To be able to use arrow back/forward for navigation

        4. To be able to go to a certain page from dropdown with availability pages

        5. To be able to type page number and after clicking on Enter will directly load that page

    2. General logic of this tab

      1. In this listing the system display liabilities and receivables together

      2. In the listing should be visibled only customer liability/receivables which current amount > 0 (by default)

        1. Customer liabilities/receivables with a current amount equal 0 should be visibled if the 'Show covered liabilities' checkbox is selected.

        2. Should display receivables with minus

      3. All amounts are in the default system currency

      4. Deleted receivables and liabilities should not be visibled in the listing.

    3. In each row in a customer receivable/liaibilities list should load:

      1. ID

        1. Format:

          1. Receivable-2099

          2. Liability-1552[SS2] [DK3] 

      2. Outoing document

        1. Should be displayed results from Outgoing document from objects (outgoing sub object)

        2. Clicking on an outgoing document should open a new tab of the outgoing document

      3. Creation date

        1. Creation date of liability/receivable

        2. Date

        3. 12.12.2024 Format: DD.MM.YYYY

    4. Due date

      1. Both liabilities and receivables should have a due date

      2. The system should display Due date for liability/receivable

      3. Date

      4. 12.12.2024 Format: DD.MM.YYYY

    5. Billing group

      1. Display billing group from liability/receivable billing group sub object

      2. If liability/receivable are without billing group , this field will be empty

    6. Contract/Order

      1. Contract/Order which is used in receivable and liability generating process

      2. If a liability or receivable is generated manually without a billing group, this field will remain empty.

      3. When a billing group is added to a manually generated liability or receivable, the contract associated with this billing group should be selected

      4. Clicking on an contract/order should open a new tab of the contract/order

    7. Initial amount

      1. All amounts should be displayed in the main currency.

      2. Receivable initial amount should be negative and with currency:

      3. -10.00 Ð»Ð². / EUR

      4. Liability initial amount should be positive or 0 and  with currency:

      5. 32.00 Ð»Ð². / EUR or 0 Ð»Ð². / EUR

    8. Current amount

      1. Current amount from liaibility/receivable object

      2. Receivable current amount should be negative or 0 and with currency:

      3. -10.00 Ð»Ð². / EUR or 0 Ð»Ð². / EUR

      4. Liability current amount should be positive or 0 with currency:

      5. 32.00 Ð»Ð². /  EUR or 0 Ð»Ð². / EUR

    9. POD

      1. PODS which are included in the billing group if separate POD is checked

      2. If a liability/receivable is created manually without a billing group, this field should remain empty.

      3. If a liability/receivable is created manually with a billing group, all PODs from this billing group should be displayed.

      4. If a liability/receivable is generated automatically, only the PODs address which are involved in the generation process should be visible.

    10. POD Address

      1. Display POD address which is used in the invoice by billing group

      2. Take data from billing group → POD → Address of the point of delivery[SS4] 

      3. Take from latest version

    11. Offsetting

      1. Display all offsettings which are conected with object

      2. Clicking on an offsetting should open a new tab of the offsetting object

  5. To display loader while loading the list

    1. Search/filter list:

      1. To be able to search receivable by predefined values:

        1. All

        2. ID

        3. Outgoing document

        4. Contract/Order number

        5. It should be filtered by exact match.

        6. POD identifier

        7. It should be filtered by exact match.

        8. POD Address

      2. Min 1 character is required to enable search icon

      3. Empty search box state with gray search/clear search icon

      4. To be able to click on a search icon to run search when min 1 character is typed

      5. To display loader while loading search result

      6. To be able to filter customer receivables/Liabilities by predefined parameters:

  6. Filters

    1. The next five checkbox should be selected automatically by default and information in th listing should filtered by them

    2. Blocked for payment

      1. Should automatically selected by default

      2. Optional

      3. Checkbox

      4. When this checkbox is selected system should check liability and display liabilities which are blocked for payment[SS5] . If checkbox is not selected the system should NOT display liabilities which are blocked for payment.

    3. Blocked for offsetting

      1. Should automatically selected by default

      2. Optional

      3. Checkbox

      4. When this checkbox is selected system should check liability/receivable and display liabilities/receivables which are blocked for offsetting process. If checkbox is not selected the system should NOT display liabilities/receivables which are blocked for offsetting process.

    4. Blocked for reminders

      1. Should automatically selected by default

      2. Optional

      3. Checkbox

      4. When this checkbox is selected system should check liability and display only them which are blocked for reminders. If checkbox is not selected the system should NOT display liabilities which are blocked for reminders

    5. Blocked for disconnection

      1. Should automatically selected by default

      2. Optional

      3. Checkbox

      4. When this checkbox is selected system should check liability and display liabilities which are blocked for disconnection. If checkbox is not selected the system should NOT display liabilities which are blocked for disconnection.

    6. Blocked for interest

      1. Should automatically selected by default

      2. Optional

      3. Checkbox

      4. When this checkbox is selected system should check liability and display liabilities which are blocked for interest. If checkbox is not selected the system should NOT display liabilities which are blocked for interest.

    7. Show deposits

      1. Optional

      2. Checkbox

      3. After choosing this checkbox in the listing should be visibled all active and paid deposits of the customer with a negative initial and current amount or 0 for current amount

    8. Show covered liabilities/receivables

      1. Optional

      2. Checkbox

      3. After choosing this checkbox in the listing should be visibled all liabilities/receivables which are current amount = 0

      4. Amound board[SS6] 

    9. Initial amount

      1. The board should display the initial amounts for both liabilities and receivables. These amounts should be dynamic, meaning they will update based on filtering or search results. The amount should equal the sum of the initial amounts of the liabilities/receivables/deposits showed futher down.

      2. The initial amount can be negative. If the initial receivables amount exceeds the liabilities, the difference should be displayed as a negative value

      3. If liabilities initial amount equal receivable display 0

    10. Current amount

      1. Current amount from liability/receivable

      2. The board should display the current amount for both liabilities and receivables. These amounts should be dynamic, meaning they will update based on filtering or search results. The amount should equal the sum of the current amounts of the liabilities/receivables/deposits showed futher down.

      3. The current amount can be negative. If the initial current receivables amount exceeds the liabilities, the difference should be displayed as a negative value

      4. If liabilities initial amount equal receivable display 0

  7. It is possible to clear filter and keep search result

  8. Up/down arrow next to column title for sorting full list

  9. ASC/DESC order

  10. All columns should be sortable

  11. Deleted/Terminated receivables are displayed in the list

  12. It is not possible to delete receivable/liability from the customer’s tab

  13. It is possible to go to the receivable/liabilities's detailed page when clicking on its name or an arrow

  14. New browser  window should be opened with the chosen receivable's preview mode

10.  Audit Log record should be created
